D-001.rationale: Sum-instead-of-average across GAS micro-steps means missing 1/N factor over N accumulation steps — classic P2 Scaling Consistency. Not P4: every microbatch backward still runs once; the numerical factor is wrong, not the call count.

D-002.rationale: ZeRO-2 backward regression makes grad_norm 50-70% lower across all DP ranks consistently. No cross-rank divergence (all ranks compute the same wrong value), no missing 1/N factor visible at hook level, no dtype shift. Bug is observable only by comparison to ZeRO-1/3 reference, which is outside P1-P8 scope.

D-003.rationale: Cross-partition gradients on non-target ranks retain unreduced local values, so DP ranks of the same parallel group disagree on the gradient. invariant_type='cross_rank_equality' explicitly. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

D-004.rationale: Uneven sequence split in SeqAllToAll produces a numerically wrong attention output (~0.68 max abs diff vs reference). Detectable only by reference oracle — no dtype, no missing N-scale, no cross-rank inequality (all SP ranks consistently wrong). None of P1-P8 fires.

D-005.rationale: Two CPUAdam paths give different bias_correction2 across subgroups within the same step → ranks/subgroups owning shards diverge in optimizer metadata. invariant_type='cross_rank_equality'. P3.

D-006.rationale: int32 overflow in TensorListMetadata makes the kernel silently skip the loop, so weights never update for >2^31-element tensors. Detectable as 'param checksum unchanged after step', but P1-P8 has no 'param-must-change' rule; not a counter-init/reset (P8) case.

D-007.rationale: Missing input validation accepts loss_scale=inf, gradients become NaN. Detection is config-validation; runtime symptom is NaN propagation but no P1-P8 invariant guards loss_scale value range. Not P1 (no dtype change), not P2 (not a 1/N factor).

D-008.rationale: DeepSpeed checkpoint+torch.compile RNG mismatch causes dropout to produce different RNG between forward and backward, slow loss divergence. Not P5 (not train↔eval restoration), not P3 (no cross-rank check). Source/integration bug; no runtime invariant fires.

D-009.rationale: ZeRO-3 overwrites user-set module.id used for expert→GPU placement → built EP topology disagrees with configured assignment. P6 Structural Integrity — wrong structural attribute vs config. Not P3: id is a structural identifier, not a value to replicate.

D-010.rationale: Multiple backward()/step pattern with CPU offload drops intermediate gradients — final params drift ~2*lr from reference. Could surface as DP cross-rank disagreement (uncertain P3) but the bug is symmetric across DP ranks; closer to a missing accumulation rather than replication. Below 60% confidence.

D-012.rationale: CPU-offload microsteps>0 silently discard gradients instead of accumulating. Symmetric across DP, no dtype issue, no missing-N scale at hook level. Bug observable only as 'grad_norm doesn't grow with microsteps' which is a temporal/statistical signal outside P1-P8.

D-013.rationale: FP16_UnfusedOptimizer applies dynamic loss scale to bf16 tensors — loss_scale path is dtype-incompatible with bf16 (a non-cast scaling op produces wrong-dtype-pathway output). Best fit P1 dtype mismatch via wrong-dtype optimizer. Not P2: factor exists but is mis-applied due to dtype, not missing 1/N.

D-016.rationale: norm_for_param_grads structure not refreshed after gradient clipping — recorded grad_norm disagrees with clipped grads. Source-level structural staleness; no dtype/scale/replication/count rule fires. Not P8 (not a counter).

D-017.rationale: micro_step_id initialized to 0 in constructor but -1 in backward path → reset/branch path inconsistent with init. Direct P8 Counter Consistency violation between init and reset code paths.

D-018.rationale: Wrong DP world_size used to build _hp_mapping → some MoE params get None mapping (structural completeness violation vs configured EP topology). P6 Structural Integrity. Not P3: parameter mapping table is structural metadata, not a runtime tensor value.

D-019.rationale: MoE EP grad_norm scaling differs from expected by ep_size factor (P2 Scaling Consistency, missing N or 1/N) AND uses wrong DP group for allreduce so EP-replicated params disagree across EP-DP ranks (P3 Cross-Rank Replication).

D-020.rationale: Wrong threadIdx index in LayerNorm CUDA kernel produces numerically wrong gamma grad. Detectable only by reference checksum; no dtype/scale/replication/structural rule applies. Source kernel bug.

D-022.rationale: Lexicographic sort of checkpoint shards (10,11,9 instead of 9,10,11) silently corrupts merged optimizer state. Filename-ordering bug detectable only against original checksum reference — no runtime P1-P8 invariant. Not P5 (P5 is state-restoration semantics, not on-disk file ordering).

D-023.rationale: Same-step subgroups produce non-bit-identical bias-correction values; ranks owning different subgroup shards disagree on Adam metadata. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

D-024.rationale: ds_secondary_tensor not synced after checkpoint load → secondary view is stale relative to ds_tensor on resume. P5 covers checkpoint save/load round-trip restoration of training-relevant state. Not P3: bug is on-rank stale buffer, not cross-rank divergence.

D-028.rationale: BF16_Optimizer accumulates in FP32 buffer but engine all-reduces the BF16 view — collective operates on the wrong-dtype tensor. invariant_type dtype_consistency ⇒ P1. Cross-rank divergence after low-precision allreduce is plausible (uncertain P3).

D-030.rationale: ZeRO-3 ignores configured comm dtype, all-gather/reduce-scatter run in wrong precision. invariant_type dtype_consistency. P1 (collective is non-cast wrt configured dtype).

D-031.rationale: MoE gate params skipped by ZeRO-2 hook → gate gradients never reduced → gate weights diverge across DP ranks. Detection signal explicitly cross-rank; P3 Cross-Rank Replication. Not P4: bug is missing call, but the runtime-observable invariant is cross-rank value divergence.

D-032.rationale: Multi-machine stage-3 universal checkpoint loads with wrong loss after resume — likely state restoration issue (P5) but detection signal is just 'loss jump', a statistical symptom. Below 60% confidence on a specific P5 instantiation.

D-033.rationale: After checkpoint load with bf16+ZeRO0, optimizer step counter, exp_avg, exp_avg_sq are not restored. Direct P5 State Restoration violation (checkpoint save/load round-trip).

D-034.rationale: SP gradient scaling uses wrong world_size factor (P2 missing/incorrect N-scale) and SP reduce executes in BF16 instead of FP32 (P1 dtype on a non-cast collective). Two independent rule violations.

D-035.rationale: ZeRO-3 grad_norm not allreduced across DP → ranks of the same DP group report different grad_norm values. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

D-036.rationale: bf16 optimizer fails to convert grads to FP32 when grad-accum dtype differs from model dtype — step receives wrong-dtype grad. invariant_type dtype_consistency ⇒ P1.

D-037.rationale: Bundled fix touches three issues: (1) gate forward casts param view to fp32 corrupting flat-buffer dtype (P1 dtype preservation on no-op pass-through); (2) top-2 aux_loss multiplied by extra num_experts factor (P2 Scaling Consistency). Capacity-not-aligned-to-TP is a structural mismatch (uncertain P6).

D-039.rationale: reduce_bucket_size influencing convergence is an emergent numerical-stability bug; no specific dtype/scale/replication/count rule fires. Source-level numeric pathology not in P1-P8 catalog.

D-041.rationale: checkpoint dir name (e.g. 800) drifts from internal global_step (799). Internal counter inconsistent between save-time naming path and step-counter path. P8 Counter Consistency.

D-042.rationale: Coalesced all-gather under autocast mixes dtypes within one collective; invariant_type dtype_consistency. P1 dtype-preservation on a non-cast collective. Param-state-tracking inconsistency is downstream symptom.

D-043.rationale: MiCS only first partition group writes checkpoint files → subsequent groups' shards missing on disk. Filesystem completeness bug, observable as missing-files; not a runtime P1-P8 invariant. Not P5 (P5 is restoration semantics, not save-time completeness).

D-044.rationale: stage3 universal checkpoint with multiple subgroups: tensor slicing OOB and concurrent-write race. Both bugs surface at save-time as data corruption / OOB errors — not catchable by runtime P1-P8 invariants on training state.

D-045.rationale: Grad-accum buffer forced to BF16 instead of FP32; non-cast accumulation operates in lower precision than configured. invariant_type dtype_consistency ⇒ P1.

D-046.rationale: MoE checkpoint with TP>1 only saves rank-0 mp file — TP shards missing from disk. Save-side completeness bug (similar to D-043). No runtime P1-P8 invariant catches a missing-on-disk shard.

M-001.rationale: Reduce-scatter-then-all-reduce ordering for shared embedding leaves wte and lm_head grads on different DP ranks → embedding grad checksum differs across PP[0] and PP[-1] within same DP group. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

M-002.rationale: CP attention backward dQ/dK/dV deviates ~1.2 relative from single-card reference. Detectable only by oracle; no dtype/scale/replication divergence pattern fires (CP ranks all wrong consistently). Source kernel bug.

M-003.rationale: Loss multiplied by cp_size in backward inflates gradients by cp_size factor. Extra N-scaling across N CP ranks ⇒ P2 Scaling Consistency violation.

M-004.rationale: MTP loss not divided by num_tokens → backward sums instead of per-token average → gradient too large by num_tokens factor. Missing 1/N normalization ⇒ P2 Scaling Consistency.

M-006.rationale: vocab_size % tp_size != 0 leads to uneven vocab partitions and structurally wrong logit slicing. Build-time structural mismatch between configured vocab and TP partitioning ⇒ P6 Structural Integrity.

M-007.rationale: All-gather not yet complete when forward consumes the bucket → some ranks see previous-step weights. detection_signal: 'param checksum on some ranks matches previous iteration'. P3 Cross-Rank Replication on the same DP group.

M-009.rationale: SP+FlashAttention skips qkv all-gather → each SP rank attends only over its local L/sp_size chunk → sequence-dim parameters effectively diverge across SP ranks. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3.

M-011.rationale: RoPE ignores reset position_ids; embedding values are computed for 0..L-1 instead of actual ids. Detectable only by oracle on sequences with reset; no dtype/scale/replication/structural runtime invariant catches this. Source-level argument-passing bug.

M-013.rationale: pad_to_capacity dummy tokens corrupt routing_map → aux_loss is constantly 1.0. Statistical/value-distribution anomaly; no dtype/scale/replication/count rule fires. Source-level routing-map construction bug.

M-015.rationale: After checkpoint resume with --override-opt_param-scheduler, get_lr keeps old max_lr/min_lr — LR scheduler state not properly restored/overridden. P5 State Restoration (checkpoint round-trip clause).

M-016.rationale: Optimizer state corrupted across save/load with --optimizer-cpu-offload, loss jumps 0.31→10 on resume. Direct P5 State Restoration violation on checkpoint round-trip.

M-017.rationale: mcore-0.12 checkpoint resume cannot reproduce pre-save loss; root_cause attributed to optimizer/RNG state not fully restored. P5 State Restoration.

M-018.rationale: RNG seed derivation produces inconsistent state across DP ranks where they should match → different dropout masks across DP. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3 Cross-Rank Replication on RNG state field.

M-019.rationale: finish_embedding_wgrad_compute is invoked after the all-reduce sync point — required call ordering/count is wrong relative to the all-reduce schedule. Closest match P4 Invocation Frequency (call must occur before reduce, not after). Cross-rank divergence is a downstream symptom (uncertain P3).

M-022.rationale: MLA softmax_factor uses mscale instead of mscale_all_dim — wrong scalar constant. Source-level wrong-variable bug; no dtype/scale/replication/count/structural runtime invariant captures 'wrong constant chosen'.

M-023.rationale: get_tensor_shapes() forgets cp_size factor → PP p2p tensor shapes don't match true activation shapes when CP enabled. Build/topology shape mismatch vs config ⇒ P6 Structural Integrity.

M-025.rationale: Master weight created in one dtype then cast instead of directly in params_dtype — non-cast init function output dtype path goes through unintended precision. P1 dtype preservation.

M-026.rationale: DDP copies params from a separate init stream without sync → bucket holds garbage/partial values; invariant_type cross_rank_equality, detection_method explicitly compares DDP-buffer checksum to source. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

M-027.rationale: int64→int32 silent overflow in sample_idx feeds wrong samples. Source-level integer-overflow bug; no P1-P8 invariant catches data-pipeline index correctness. Not P1 (intra-tensor scalar conversion not a function-output dtype).

M-028.rationale: RoPE position-embedding split across CP ranks may assign wrong sin/cos slices → CP ranks compute embeddings inconsistent with the global sequence position layout. Cross-rank-of-same-CP-group disagreement on a replicated/sharded buffer ⇒ P3.

M-029.rationale: torch.compile recompile-limit hit during PPO breaks autograd graph — c10d::broadcast_ has no autograd kernel so grads are silently wrong. Source/integration bug; symptom is incorrect gradient values but no specific dtype/scale/replication invariant fires deterministically.

M-030.rationale: First step after checkpoint resume uses old LR despite --override flag — LR field not properly overridden after restore. P5 State Restoration.

M-031.rationale: MXFP8 gradient buffer reuse without overlap-grad-reduce corrupts grad buffer → NaN. Source-level buffer-lifetime bug; symptom is NaN loss. No specific dtype/scale/replication/count rule applies (NaN is downstream).

M-032.rationale: MLA implementation produces unexpected loss values vs non-MLA reference. Detectable only by oracle reference; no dtype/scale/replication invariant fires. Source-level algorithmic bug.

M-034.rationale: DDP post-hook on side stream allows reduce-scatter to launch before hook completes → grad checksum diverges across DP ranks. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

M-035.rationale: TE fused_attn_bwd produces dQ with relative error >1.0 for deep models. Detectable only by reference comparison; no dtype/scale/replication invariant fires (TP ranks all consistently wrong). Source-level kernel bug.

M-036.rationale: TE silently uses causal mask, ignoring user-provided block-diagonal attention_mask in packed-sequence training. Source-level argument-honoring bug; no runtime invariant catches a wrong mask choice.

M-037.rationale: YarnRotaryEmbedding instantiated without forwarding rotary_interleaved → frequency layout mismatches application logic. Source-level argument-forwarding bug; no dtype/scale/replication/structural rule applies.

M-038.rationale: When CP is on, num_microbatches is multiplied by cp_size but MTPLossAutoScaler does not compensate → MTP grad scaled down by cp_size. Missing N (or 1/N) factor across N CP ranks ⇒ P2 Scaling Consistency.

M-039.rationale: MoE gate not partitioned across TP ranks when kv_head < tp_size — every TP rank holds the full gate (shape identical when it should be sliced). detection_signal: 'gate weight shape identical across TP ranks when it should be sliced'. P3 cross-rank replication of a tensor that should be sharded; structural shape mismatch is also plausible (uncertain P6).

M-040.rationale: First-iteration gradient buffer not zeroed because finish_param_sync skipped → stale init values pollute first grad. Buffer-init bug; not a counter (P8 is about counter monotonicity), no dtype/scale/replication rule applies.

M-041.rationale: FlashSelfAttention.eval() sets dropout_p=0 permanently and never restores on the way back to train mode. Direct P5 State Restoration violation on the train→eval→train transition (the canonical P5 case).

M-042.rationale: save-interval=20 emits checkpoint with empty optimizer state (missing exp_avg). Save-side completeness bug; would manifest at restore as KeyError (uncertain P5). The bug is at save-time state-population, not at restore-time, so P5 fit is weak.

O-001.rationale: Sequential block reuses self.norm for both attn and FFN paths instead of a separate self.norm2 — shared module identity rather than independent params. Source-level structural-coupling bug not catchable by P1-P8 (norm is structurally present, just shared).

O-004.rationale: FSDP reduce_dtype=bfloat16 means gradient reduce is performed in bf16 across the cluster — non-cast collective output dtype is wrong relative to the fp32 accumulator semantics. P1 dtype preservation on the reduce primitive.

O-007.rationale: flash-attn renamed kwarg ignored_index→ignore_index; OLMo passes the old kwarg silently absorbed via **kwargs, padding tokens enter loss. API-rename bug; no dtype/scale/replication/count rule catches a silently-ignored kwarg.

O-008.rationale: Unsharded checkpoint save bug → resume produces discontinuous loss. Could be a P5 state-restoration manifestation (uncertain) but root_cause is vague ('saved state incomplete/incorrect'); detection is loss-discontinuity, a statistical signal.

O-011.rationale: All blocks share the same RoPE buffer under CP → block-i and block-j ranks see identical positional encodings instead of per-chunk slices. detection_signal: 'RoPE buffer identical across blocks when should differ'. P3-style replication-vs-sharding violation.

O-012.rationale: LMHead under TP wraps ce_loss/z_loss as distributed tensor incorrectly and w_out lacks TP wrapper → param distribution differs across TP ranks vs other params. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3.

O-013.rationale: Buggy fused CE-loss kernel consistently underperforms vs native PyTorch CE. Detectable only by oracle reference; no dtype/scale/replication/count rule fires. Source-level kernel-implementation bug.

O-015.rationale: All-zero instance mask divides by zero → NaN loss on a degenerate batch. Numerical edge-case; symptom is NaN loss but no specific P1-P8 invariant fires (NaN propagation is downstream, no dtype/scale/replication issue).

O-017.rationale: Cosine+warmup+linear-decay scheduler init logic produces the wrong schedule. Source-level logic bug; detectable only by comparing actual LR trace to expected. No P1-P8 runtime invariant fires.

O-018.rationale: ReorderedNormTransformerBlock + fine-grained FSDP wrap + activation-checkpointing interaction yields wrong fwd/bwd results. Integration bug detectable only by reference-vs-actual comparison; no specific dtype/scale/replication rule catches it.

O-019.rationale: Eval data-loader bookkeeping not reset between repeated runs → data-order drift. Source-level state-reset bug in eval pipeline (not the train/eval/train P5 transition). No runtime invariant on data-loader determinism in P1-P8.

O-020.rationale: SourceMixtureDataset truncates source files instead of random sampling. Source-level data-pipeline bug; coverage skew detectable only by long-horizon sampling distribution. No runtime P1-P8 invariant applies.

O-024.rationale: Self-equality (==) check guard never fires → depth-scaled init never applied; all layers get the same scale. Source-level wrong-comparison bug at init. detection_signal would be uniform scale across layers — not a P6 structural shape mismatch and not a runtime cross-rank rule.

O-026.rationale: FSDP FULL_SHARD silently ignores load_state_dict invoked between forward and backward — checkpoint not actually applied. P5 State Restoration violation on the load path.

O-027.rationale: torch.compile CSE eliminates ops after non-functionalized fsdp.set_, returning pre-set value. Source-level compile/aliasing bug; symptom is compile-vs-eager divergence — no specific P1-P8 dtype/scale/replication/count rule applies.

O-028.rationale: model.eval() under FSDP fails to cast all params to full precision — F.scaled_dot_product_attention receives mixed fp32/bf16 inputs. invariant_type dtype_consistency ⇒ P1 dtype-preservation on attention input. The eval-path issue also has weak P5 flavor (uncertain).

O-029.rationale: FSDP+CPU-offload outside no_sync replaces accumulated grad with newly reduced grad rather than adding. Could surface as cross-rank/cross-microstep grad mismatch (uncertain P3) but the bug is symmetric across DP ranks. Closer to a missing-accumulation than missing-replication.

O-030.rationale: FSDP+PP zero-bubble backward skips _root_post_backward_final_callback → race between reduce-scatter and grad read; gradient values become non-deterministic across ranks. invariant_type cross_rank_equality. P3 Cross-Rank Replication.

O-031.rationale: FSDP reduce_dtype=bf16 means cross-cluster gradient reduction is performed in bf16 — same shape as O-004 (non-cast collective in wrong precision). P1 dtype preservation on the reduce primitive.

O-032.rationale: Per-rank epsilon (1e-6) added before global all-reduce of total_norm → eps gets multiplied effectively by world_size (or amplified when summed). Wrong N-scaling on a globally-reduced quantity ⇒ P2 Scaling Consistency.

O-033.rationale: FSDP use_orig_params + FULL_SHARD: inner module state_dict missing some params vs wrapped model. State-dict-completeness bug at save/gather time; no P1-P8 runtime invariant catches missing keys. Not P5 (P5 is restoration semantics, not state_dict construction).
